answer: In fiscal year 2022, AMD's operating margin decreased to approximately 5.36% ($1,264 million operating income on $23,601 million net revenue) from approximately 22.20% ($3,648 million operating income on $16,434 million net revenue) in fiscal year 2021. This decrease was primarily driven by significant amortization of acquisition-related intangibles and higher stock-based compensation and acquisition-related costs resulting from the Xilinx acquisition.
